name: Starlight Stayover
source:
On your way to Crown Harbor, you decided to stop in at a little place called Lustrum Lane, a gloomy little place on the shore with just one resident...

[From [url=https://growleaf.itch.io/starlight-stayover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在前往皇冠港的旅途中，你决定顺道在海畔一处名叫卢斯特伦巷的阴郁小地方落脚歇息——而这里仅仅住着一位居民……
